paite: Paul, Jesu Khrist sikha, sawltak hi ding a sap, Pathian tanchinhoih lam a khenkhiak,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

paite: Pathian in tuma lam a Laisiangthou a azawlneite a achiamsa,
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

paite: atapa, salam a David suan a piang tungtang thu,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

paite: amah Pathian Tapa hihna bel misi lak a kipan thilhihtheihna toh athohnawnna ziak a sianthouna Kha in Jesu Khrist, Toupa chi a apuankhiak ahi.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

paite: Amin ziak a ginna nam chih lak a mi gingtasak ding in, amah ziak in hehpihna leh sawltak hihna i tangta hi;
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

paite: huai lak ah nou leng Jesu Khrist sapte na hi uh;
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

paite: Rome khua Pathian deihtak, misiangthou a om ding a sapte tengteng kiang ah, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Amasa in khovel tengteng ah na ginna uh athan ziak in na vek ua tung ah ka kipahthu Jesu Khrist ziak in ka Pathian kiang ah ka gen hi.
heading: Paul In Romete Veh Atupna
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

paite: Ka thumnate ah tawp lou in na min uh ka lou nilouh ahi, chih kei hon theihpihpa Pathian ahi a, amah ahi a Tapa tanchinhoih gen a ka kha a, a-nna ka sep gige pa pen;
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

paite: tu bek a na kiang ua ka hong theihna ding in Pathian thuthu a zin hun lemtang ka muh teitei theihna ding ka ngen hi.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

paite: Na kipna ding ua khalam thilpiak banghiam nou ka hon piaktheihna ding in nou hon muh ka ut thei mahmah ngal a;
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

paite: huai na ginna uh leh ka ginna a i kikhamuantuah theihna ding un ka chihna ahi.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

paite: Unaute aw, Zentel dangte kiang a ka sepgim gah ka muhtak bangmah in, noumau lak ah leng gahte ka muhtheihna ding in na kiang uah tamveipi hong ka tumta chih na theih louh uh ka deih kei hi; himahleh tu tanpha dal in ka om nilouh hi.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

paite: Grik mite leh melmak mite kiang ah bat ka nei a; mipil leh mipilloute kiang ah leng.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

paite: Huchi in nou Rome a omte kiang ah leng tanchinhoih gen ka ut mahmah hi.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

paite: Tanchinhoih tuh ka zahpih kei a; kuapeuh agingta phot a ding in hotdamna ding a Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi ngal a; atung in Juda mi a ding in ahi a, huan Grik mi a ding in leng ahong hi nawn hi.
heading: Gospel Thilhihtheihna
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

paite: Huai ah tuh gin semsemna ding in ginna in Pathian diktatna latsak in a-om hi, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

paite: Dik loutak a thutak dalte leh Pathian limsaklouhna leh diktatlouhna tengteng tung ah van a kipan in Pathian thangpaihna ahong kilangta hi.
heading: Khelhna Tung A Pathian Thangpaihna
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

paite: Pathian in atheihsak tak ziak in Pathian tanchin theihtheih ding tuh alungsim uah chiangtak a theihsak in a-omta ngal a.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

paite: Khovel siam tung a kipan a pianken muh theih louh, atangtawn thilhihtheihna leh a Pathianna, thilsiamte ah chiantak a muh theih ahi; huaiziak in paulam ding anei kei uhi.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

paite: Pathian thei ngal in Pathian bang in apahtawi kei ua; kipahthu leng agen sam kei uh; himahleh thil thulim lou angaihtuah zaw ua, alungtang hai uh ahong mialta hi.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

paite: Pil kisa khem in mihai ahong suak ua,
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

paite: asithei lou Pathian thupina sithei mihingte leh vasate, gamsate leh bokvak ganhingte lim asuaksak uhi.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

paite: Huaiziak in asa uh zumhuaipi a kibawltuah ding in alungtang uh duhgawlna bang a thilnin hihphal in Pathian in alehngatsan hi.
heading: Zentelte Khelhna
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

paite: Pathian thutak tuh zuau tangsak in, abawlpa biak sang in abawl bia in a-nna asem uhi. Abawlpa tuh tangtawn a phat tuak ahi, Amen.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in zumhuaipi a huk phal in lehlam angatsanta hi; anumeite nangawn un leng a-omdan pianpih uh dan lou bang a om ding in akibawl lamdang ua;
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

paite: pasalte'n leng numei zatdan ngeina tawpsan in, huk in aki-enlahtuah ua, pasal leh pasal zummoh thilhih in a-om uh; agitlouh man muh ding uh asa tung ua mu in.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

paite: Huan Pathian theih a-ut louh ziak un, thil kilawmloute hih ding a adeih louh lam lungsim neih phal in Pathian in alehngatsanta hi.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

paite: Huchi in diktatlouhna, gitlouhna, huaihamna, huatna in adim ua; hazatna, tualthahna, kiselna, khemna, nundan hoih lou in adim ua;
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

paite: gensiatnate, migennate, Pathian huat lamte, kisaktheihnate, kisathei mite, thil gilou bawlkhete,
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

paite: nu leh pa thu mangloute, theihna beite, thuchiam susete, itna pianpih neiloute, hehpihna neiloute ahi uhi.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

paite: Huchibang hihte tuh si tak him ahi uh chih Pathian dan tuh theigige in, amau kia a hih leng hilou in, midang hih zelte tung ah leng akipak uhi.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
